props.name: direction
props.description: Sets where the tooltip renders in relation to the target.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to be displayed in the tooltip

props.name: type
props.description: The type of tooltip. `label` is used for labelling the element that triggers tooltip. `description` is used for describing or adding a supplementary information to the element that triggers the tooltip.

props.name: keybindingHint
props.description: Optional keybinding hint to indicate the availability of a keyboard shortcut. Pass a string for a single shortcut or an array of strings to show multiple shortcuts joined with "or". Supported syntax is described in the docs for the `KeybindingHint` component.

props.name: delay
props.description: Sets the delay before showing the tooltip. `short` is 50ms (default), `medium` is 400ms, and `long` is 1200ms.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the tooltip.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the tooltip open state changes. Call `change.cancel()` to prevent the transition.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger and popup parts rendered within the tooltip root context. `Tooltip.Root` renders no DOM element (state and context only).

props.name: id
props.description: Optional ID used to link `Tooltip.Trigger` and `Tooltip.Popup` deterministically during SSR.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the tooltip.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the tooltip open state changes. Call `change.cancel()` to prevent the transition.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before showing the tooltip on hover (`short` 50ms, `medium` 400ms, `long` 1200ms).

props.name: type
props.description: Whether the tooltip labels or describes its trigger element.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents the tooltip from opening and closes it if currently open.

props.name: as
props.description: Render the trigger as a different element or component instead of the default `<button type="button">`. `ref` forwards to the rendered trigger `HTMLElement`, and `data-open` is set while open. Cannot be combined with `render`.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default `<button type="button">` trigger element with a custom element or render function receiving merged props (including `ref` to the rendered trigger `HTMLElement` and `data-open` when open) and state. Cannot be combined with `as`.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the trigger element (defaults to `<button type="button">` with `ref` pointing to the rendered trigger `HTMLElement` and `data-open` when open).

props.name: type
props.description: Button type attribute used when rendering the default native `<button>` element.

props.name: as
props.description: Render the popup as a different element or component instead of the default `<span>`. `ref` forwards to the rendered popup `HTMLElement`, with `data-direction` and `data-open` state attributes. Cannot be combined with `render`.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default `<span>` popup element with a custom element or render function receiving merged props (including `ref` to the rendered popup `HTMLElement`, `data-direction`, and `data-open`) and state. Cannot be combined with `as`.

props.name: direction
props.description: Sets where the tooltip renders in relation to its trigger. Reflected and collision-adjusted via `data-direction` on the rendered popup.

props.name: keybindingHint
props.description: Optional keybinding hint displayed next to the tooltip content.

props.name: children
props.description: Non-interactive content rendered inside the tooltip popup (defaults to `<span>` with `ref` pointing to the rendered popup `HTMLElement` and `data-direction`/`data-open` state attributes).
